explanations.16: white-space: nowrap prevents text from wrapping to multiple lines, so the question stays on one line even in tight spaces.
explanations.26: inline-flex makes the button shrink to fit its content (like text and icons) instead of taking full width.
explanations.36: transition is a shorthand that smoothly animates changes to background-color, border-color, and text color over 0.15 seconds when you hover.
